verdict.rationale: A data-storing product can fairly be asked about a training opt-out or no-training policy, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no statement, policy, or control from Milvus about whether user data is used for AI model training. Local and self-hosted deployment options (Milvus Lite, Standalone) are a related deployment choice, not a documented no-training guarantee or opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
